# NullGraph

> Repository-side agent kit for manifest version 1.1.1. This file is an index, not an executable module.
> Start with the guide. Follow only the links relevant to the task.

## Start here
- [Agent entry point](docs/agent/llms.txt): discovery, access modes, and task routing.
- [Agent guide](docs/agent/guide.md): setup, runnable examples, frame contracts, and pitfalls.
- [Validation](docs/agent/validation.md): commands, evidence levels, and open platform pointers.

## Delivery
The npm package ships the engine, declarations, and README, not this kit or the render harness.
An agent must be given this repository or explicitly fetch its entry point; npm install alone
does not load instructions into an agent. Publication of the v1.1.1 tag remains a release step.

## Avoid as default context
Design specs, roadmaps, and maintainer handoffs are not application API guides. Do not infer
shipped functionality from a proposal. Prefer the installed declarations and linked API docs.
